name: How can I ensure my remodeling project stays within budget?

mainEntity.name: How can I ensure my remodeling project stays within budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: To keep your remodeling project within budget, establish a realistic budget early on and communicate it clearly with your contractor. Select materials and finishes that align with your financial plan, and be prepared for potential unforeseen issues by setting aside a contingency fund, typically 10-15% of the total project cost. Deciding on key elements early and avoiding significant changes during construction can prevent cost overruns.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stay on budget by setting a realistic budget, communicating it, selecting appropriate materials, and having a contingency fund to avoid unexpected costs.
